Cleanse

Signature Botanical Black Soap

Clarifying & Radiance-Boosting African Black Soap Paste

₦6,000
About the Product

Turn your everyday bath into a botanical skincare ritual. Our Signature Black Soap Paste is handcrafted with traditional West African black soap, raw honey, nourishing plant lipids, and a powerful blend of skin-loving botanicals. Formulated with Licorice Root, Turmeric, White Mulberry, Neem, and Camwood, it helps cleanse congested skin, improve the appearance of uneven tone, and gently remove dull surface buildup. Available in our Classic Herbal Botanical formula and Kojic Radiance variation, infused with Kojic Acid Dipalmitate for targeted care.

Key Benefits
  • Helps Improve the Appearance of Dark Spots & Tan — supports a more even-looking complexion
  • Deep Clarifying Cleanse — helps remove dirt, excess oil, and impurities
  • Smoother-Looking Skin — gentle botanical exfoliation helps improve rough, dull-looking skin
  • Body Acne Care — helps keep blemish-prone skin clean and refreshed
How to Use
  1. Scoop a small amount onto wet palms or an exfoliating sponge.
  2. Lather and massage gently onto damp skin using circular motions.
  3. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
  4. Follow with Glow Nature Body Oil while skin is still slightly damp.
Exfoliate

Turmeric Polish Sugar Scrub

Exfoliating & Tone-Evening Body Polish

₦5,000
About the Product

Buff away dull surface buildup and reveal smoother, softer, glowing-looking skin. Our Emulsified Turmeric Sugar Scrub combines fine brown sugar crystals with a nourishing botanical oil blend, including Turmeric, Licorice Root, and White Mulberry. Its luxurious formula transforms into a lightweight, creamy lotion when mixed with water and rinses away cleanly — leaving skin feeling soft, smooth, and hydrated without a greasy after-feel.

Key Benefits
  • Gentle Exfoliation — helps remove dead surface cells and smooth rough areas
  • Tone-Evening Care — supports a more even-looking complexion
  • Soft, Smooth Skin — helps reveal fresh, touchably soft skin
  • Clean Rinse — washes away easily without a heavy or sticky residue
How to Use
  1. After cleansing, apply a generous amount to damp skin.
  2. Massage gently in circular motions, focusing on rough or uneven areas such as elbows and knees.
  3. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
  4. Use 2–3 times weekly.
Nourish

About the Product

Lock in moisture and give your skin a smooth, healthy-looking glow. About the Product

Handcrafted with Turmeric, Raw Honey, and nourishing plant oils, our Turmeric Brightening Bar provides a gentle yet effective cleanse for both face and body.
